_readme: Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/build_whoweare.py
It regenerates every HTML page in drafts/whoweare-redesign/.
'images' / 'videos' = how many empty placeholder slots that block gets.
'source' = the existing live page the material came from (shown as an
archive link; add "cta": true to render it as a button instead).
'note' = an amber flag on the page; 'todo' = a dashed box standing in
for copy that still has to be written.
'avatar' = a file in avatars/. Unassigned programmes use generic.png.
'status': 'past' moves a programme out of the main grid into the quiet 'Past programmes' list at the foot of its category page.
'page.mascots' = the avatars in the banner row. Four fits a phone; more will shrink them.

page.title: Who We Are
page.intro: A grassroots parenting community since 2007, run entirely by volunteer families. Everything below is something our members organise themselves.
page.intro_zh: 自2007年起的民间父母社区，完全由义工家庭运营。以下每一项活动，都由会员自己组织。

categories.title: Learning & Enrichment
categories.intro: Talks and study groups organised by the parents. Most of what we know, we teach each other.
categories.intro_zh: 由家长组织的讲座与学习小组。我们所知道的，大多来自彼此。

subcategories.title: Parent Education Talks
subcategories.summary: Parents teaching parents — admissions, safety, and practical life.
subcategories.summary_zh: 家长教家长：升学、安全与生活实用话题。
subcategories.description: Parents teaching parents. Around twenty talks so far, covering college and high-school admissions, personal safety with the Bellevue Police Department, and practical life topics such as home renovation, recycling and family travel. Talks are usually given by a member who knows the subject first-hand.
subcategories.description_zh: 由家长主讲、为家长而办的讲座。迄今已举办约二十场，内容涵盖升学申请、与贝尔维尤警局合作的安全讲座，以及装修、回收、家庭旅行等生活实用话题。主讲人通常是亲身了解该主题的会员。

subcategories.title: Study Groups
subcategories.summary: Raz-Kids reading and the K–5 Math Challenge.
subcategories.summary_zh: Raz-Kids 阅读与 K–5 数学挑战。
subcategories.description: Small, parent-organised groups that meet regularly, and both are running now: a Raz-Kids reading group and the K–5 Math Challenge. Groups start when a few families want the same thing, so new ones can be proposed at any time.
subcategories.description_zh: 家长自发组织、定期聚会的小型学习小组，目前两个都在进行中：Raz-Kids 阅读小组与 K–5 数学挑战。小组由几个需求相同的家庭发起，随时欢迎提出新的学习小组。

categories.title: Youth Leadership
categories.intro: Programmes the young people run themselves. They organise, teach, edit and lead; the parents stay in the background.
categories.intro_zh: 由青少年自己运营的项目。他们组织、教学、编辑与带领，家长退居幕后。

subcategories.title: HackFest
subcategories.summary: Twice-yearly hackathon with its own website.
subcategories.summary_zh: 每年两届，已有独立网站的黑客松。
subcategories.description: Eleven hackathons since January 2021, now held twice a year. Youth teams build a project around a theme and present it to judges; the most recent, SafeHack, ran at DigiPen in September 2026. The teams are formed and mentored by EmP youth, and the event has grown large enough to keep its own site for schedules, rules and registration.
subcategories.description_zh: 自2021年1月起已举办十一届，目前每年两次。青少年组队围绕主题开发项目并向评委展示；最近一届 SafeHack 于2026年9月在 DigiPen 举行。参赛队伍由协会青少年自己组建与指导；活动规模已大到拥有独立网站，用于发布赛程、规则与报名。
subcategories.source_label: Schedules, rules and registration on emphackfest.org

subcategories.title: Camps & Classes
subcategories.summary: Summer camps designed and taught by EmP teenagers.
subcategories.summary_zh: 由协会青少年自己设计并教学的夏令营。
subcategories.description: Summer camps and classes designed and taught by EmP teenagers, including a ten-week camp run with the Salvation Army. Past sessions have covered Python, drama, soccer and robotics. Teens propose the camp, recruit their own team and run it; parents handle logistics only. The campers are the younger children of the community.
subcategories.description_zh: 由协会青少年自己设计与教学的夏令营和课程，包括与救世军合作的十周营队。往期内容涵盖 Python、戏剧、足球与机器人。营队由青少年自己提案、组队并主办，家长只负责后勤；营员则是社区里更小的孩子。

subcategories.title: Writing
subcategories.summary: A youth writing and art publication, edited by students.
subcategories.summary_zh: 由学生自己编辑的青少年写作与艺术刊物。
subcategories.description: A youth writing and art publication with 28 series to date, plus writing contests with cash prizes. Submissions come from elementary through high school, and the editorial work is done by student volunteers.
subcategories.description_zh: 青少年写作与艺术刊物，已发表28个系列，并举办有奖征文。投稿来自小学到高中各年龄段，编辑工作全部由学生义工完成。

subcategories.title: Creative Arts
subcategories.summary: The dance club, taught by EmP teenagers, plus instruments.
subcategories.summary_zh: 由协会青少年授课的舞蹈社，以及器乐社。
subcategories.note: New page. The dance half below is drawn from the current weekly-activities announcement.
subcategories.description: EmP 舞蹈社 runs a Saturday morning workshop series taught by EmP teenagers — ballet, K-pop, jazz and modern, and Chinese dance, for ages four and up. Sessions are small, no experience is needed, and the aim is to help a child find the style that suits them before committing to outside classes.
subcategories.description_zh: EmP舞蹈社每周六上午开设体验系列课程，由协会青少年小老师授课，涵盖芭蕾、K-pop、爵士与现代舞、中国舞，适合4岁以上。小班教学、零基础即可参加，目的是帮助孩子在报名校外课程前找到适合自己的舞种。
subcategories.todo: Instrument group 器乐社 — write a short description here. Who leads it, how often it meets, what ages, and what the group actually does.
subcategories.source_label: Current schedule on EmP Weekly Activities

subcategories.title: Gavel Club
subcategories.summary: Rising Speakers — members ran the meetings themselves.
subcategories.summary_zh: Rising Speakers：会员自主主持每周例会。
subcategories.description: Rising Speakers Gavel Club met weekly for ages 10 to 17. Members chaired the meetings themselves, gave prepared and impromptu speeches, and evaluated one another. The club is no longer running.
subcategories.description_zh: Rising Speakers 演讲俱乐部曾每周聚会一次，面向10至17岁。会员自主主持会议，进行备稿与即兴演讲，并互相点评。该俱乐部现已停止活动。
subcategories.note: Which years did the club run? The site does not record a start or end date.

categories.title: Community Service
categories.intro: How we give back to Greater Seattle — the parks, our neighbours, and families who need a hand.
categories.intro_zh: 我们回馈大西雅图社区的方式：公园、邻里，以及需要帮助的家庭。

subcategories.title: Adopt-a-Park
subcategories.summary: Juanita Woodlands and other King County parks.
subcategories.summary_zh: Juanita Woodlands 及金郡其他公园。
subcategories.description: EmP families adopted Juanita Woodlands in 2014 and maintained it through 2023; we now work in other King County parks as well. Work parties run several times a year — clearing invasive plants, spreading mulch and planting. Younger children are welcome and the hours count toward school service requirements.
subcategories.description_zh: 协会家庭于2014年认养 Juanita Woodlands 并维护至2023年，如今也在金郡其他公园服务。每年举办数次劳动日：清除入侵植物、铺覆盖物与种植。欢迎低龄儿童参加，服务时数可计入学校要求。

subcategories.title: Service Projects
subcategories.summary: Shelter blankets, bike recycling, meals, food forest.
subcategories.summary_zh: 猫毯、自行车回收、爱心餐与社区菜园。
subcategories.description: One-off and seasonal projects, chosen and led by the families who propose them: blankets for an animal shelter, bicycle recycling, cooking meals at the Ronald McDonald House, and work at the Beacon Hill Food Forest. Volunteer hours accumulate toward the President's Volunteer Service Award, which several of our youth members have received.
subcategories.description_zh: 由提案家庭自主选择与带领的单次或季节性项目：为动物收容所制作猫毯、旧自行车回收、在麦当劳之家做饭，以及 Beacon Hill Food Forest 的园艺工作。义工时数可累计申请总统义工服务奖，协会已有多位青少年会员获奖。

subcategories.title: EmPactful Connections
subcategories.summary: Youth volunteers with the autism community.
subcategories.summary_zh: 青少年义工长期陪伴自闭症群体。
subcategories.description: A partnership with International Buddy. EmP youth volunteers spent time with children in the autism community and helped them train for Special Olympics events. The programme is no longer running.
subcategories.description_zh: 与 International Buddy 的合作项目。协会青少年义工陪伴自闭症儿童，并协助他们为特奥会做训练。该项目现已结束。
subcategories.note: Which years did this run? The site does not record a start or end date.

categories.title: Culture & Celebration
categories.intro: The festivals, the traditions and the friendships that keep families coming back year after year.
categories.intro_zh: 节庆、传统与友情——让家庭年复一年回来的理由。

subcategories.title: Summer Track & Field Meet
subcategories.summary: Our biggest day of the year — 400+ people, every age.
subcategories.summary_zh: 一年中最盛大的一天：四百余人，老少同场。
subcategories.description: The largest thing EmP does. The 8th meet was held in 2026, and it runs every June: more than 400 participants of all ages — toddlers through grandparents — take part in track events, relays, tug-of-war and family games. For many families this is the day they first met EmP.
subcategories.description_zh: 协会规模最大的活动。第八届运动会于2026年举行，每年六月如期而至：四百余位男女老少参加田径、接力、拔河与家庭趣味项目。对许多家庭而言，这是他们第一次认识协会的日子。

subcategories.title: Spring Festival
subcategories.summary: Performances, a shared meal, the whole community together.
subcategories.summary_zh: 演出、年夜饭，全社区齐聚一堂。
subcategories.description: Our Lunar New Year celebration brings the whole community together for children's performances, a shared meal, and the traditions families want their children to grow up with. It is the cultural anchor of the year.
subcategories.description_zh: 协会的农历新年庆祝活动，全社区齐聚一堂：孩子们的表演、共享的年夜饭，以及家长希望孩子传承下去的年节传统。这是我们一年中的文化重心。

subcategories.title: Family Traditions
subcategories.summary: Group camping and the graduation celebration.
subcategories.description: The smaller traditions that keep coming back. Group camping takes families out of the city together for a weekend, and the graduation celebration sends off our high-school seniors each spring.
subcategories.description_zh: 年年延续的小传统。集体露营让家庭们一起走出城市共度周末；毕业庆祝则在每年春天为高中毕业生送行。

subcategories.title: Kids' Seasonal Fun
subcategories.summary: Halloween, Christmas crafts and game nights.
subcategories.summary_zh: 万圣节、圣诞手工与游戏之夜。
subcategories.description: Activities built around the calendar for younger children: Halloween on the Hill with the Bellevue Police Department, Christmas crafts and game nights. Most are short, indoor and easy to bring a small child to.
subcategories.description_zh: 跟着节令走的低龄儿童活动：与贝尔维尤警局合办的 Halloween on the Hill、圣诞手工与游戏之夜。多数活动时间短、在室内进行，带小小孩也很轻松。

subcategories.title: Parents' Social Life
subcategories.summary: Mom's Out, Dad's Out, and the Empty Nesters group.
subcategories.summary_zh: Mom's Out、Dad's Out 与空巢群。
subcategories.description: Time for the parents themselves. Mom's Out and Dad's Out meet through the year — hiking, ping-pong, classes, dinners — and the 空巢群 Empty Nesters group brings together families whose children have left home. Around twenty-five gatherings are on record.
subcategories.description_zh: 属于家长自己的时间。Mom's Out 与 Dad's Out 全年不定期举行——爬山、乒乓、课程、聚餐；空巢群则让孩子离家的家庭重新聚在一起。已记录的聚会约有二十五次。

subcategories.title: 景行 Jingxing
subcategories.summary: Student writing, essay contests and the 二十四节气 series.
subcategories.summary_zh: 学生写作、征文比赛与二十四节气系列。
subcategories.description: The Jingxing Cultural Discovery Program invites students to explore Chinese culture through their own writing. It runs essay contests, publishes the students' work, and is edited by a team of youth volunteers. Its longest-running thread follows the twenty-four 节气 solar terms — the food, the customs and the writing that belong to each one.
subcategories.description_zh: 景行文化探索项目邀请学生以自己的写作探索中华文化。项目举办征文比赛、发表学生作品，并由青少年编辑团队负责编辑。其中延续最久的系列，是跟着二十四节气走的专题——每个节气的饮食、习俗与相关写作。

milestones.title: EmP Milestones
milestones.description: Our history since 2007, year by year.
